ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 12:1 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels; the surface is predominantly low-intensity with sparse, high-contrast markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white clusters are concentrated at the distal right tip; several distinct white circular blobs (approximately 5-10 pixel diameter) are mapped in the central right lobe; white linear streaks are mapped along the superior margins of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 48 degrees; the vertex of the notch is partially occluded by low-intensity water spray/pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire continuous trailing edge; significant jagged peaks (5-15 pixels in amplitude) are concentrated on the distal half of the right lobe; left lobe exhibits a more uniform, lower-amplitude serration map.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a distinct concave curve from the median notch to the distal tips, while the superior margins exhibit a convex curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple distinct high-contrast circular rings and solid white blobs located in the medial and distal sections of the right lobe; a large, irregular high-intensity cluster is located at the extreme right tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several white linear markings, including parallel rake-like streaks, are visible on the upper portion of the left lobe and the central-upper portion of the right lobe, oriented roughly perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular white scarring and potential barnacle colonization at the right fluke tip; multiple circular 'cookie-cutter' style ring scars visible on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple dark, low-intensity rounded shapes are visible in the background water area surrounding the fluke, indicating high density of non-water objects in the field of view.
